vault-table-css
pairs.new: .content-vault-empty{padding:50px 10px;text-align:center;color:var(--ink-2);font:.8rem/1.5 var(--font-body);}.content-table-wrap{overflow-x:auto;margin:14px 0;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;}table.content-table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;font:400 .8rem/1.55 var(--font-body,'Space Grotesk',sans-serif);color:var(--ink-1);}table.content-table th,table.content-table td{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);border-right:1px solid var(--line);padding:7px 10px;text-align:left;vertical-align:top;}table.content-table th:last-child,table.content-table td:last-child{border-right:0;}table.content-table tr:last-child td{border-bottom:0;}table.content-table thead th{color:var(--ink-0);font-weight:700;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 8%,transparent);white-space:nowrap;}table.content-table tbody tr:nth-child(even){background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--ink-0) 3%,transparent);}
